title: AND, OR, and NOT Operators
description: Use AND, OR, and NOT to combine conditions.

data.text: Use AND, OR, and NOT to build compound predicates. Parentheses control precedence.

data.title: Compound Predicates
data.content: Combine conditions with AND and OR
data.code:
SELECT id, name
FROM products
WHERE (category = $1 OR category = $2)
  AND price > 0
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

data.title: Predicate Logic
data.text: Use parentheses to avoid unexpected logic precedence.
